senses.gloss: [to bend the fingers, form a hollow of the hand, denom. חוֹפֶן; whence] to take handfuls.
units: Maas. Sh. II, 5 אם בלל וח׳ וכ׳ if he mixed the coins up and took by handfuls, you go by the proportion of the coins mixed. Y. ib. 53ᶜ כבולל וחוֹפֵן it is as in the case of him who &c.—Esp. (of the priest) to take grabs of incense with both hands (v. חֲפִינָה).
<cite ref="Yoma 47a:1">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>היה חוֹפֵן וכ׳</he> used to grab &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be grabbed. Y. Maas. Sh. l. c. הנבללין והנֶחְפָּנִין the coins which were mixed up and then collected by handfuls.
